info.name: Dog API Production Ready
info.description: API collection for the Dog API Production Ready Spring Boot application. Includes custom health endpoints and Spring Boot Actuator endpoints.

item.name: Health
item.description: Health check endpoints for monitoring application status

request.description: Simple health check endpoint that returns 'UP' if the application process is responding. Useful for quick sanity checks.

item.name: Actuator
item.description: Spring Boot Actuator endpoints for production monitoring and management

request.description: Returns the overall health status of the application including all health indicators.
Kubernetes liveness probe endpoint. If this returns DOWN, the platform should restart the container.
Kubernetes readiness probe endpoint. If this returns DOWN, the application should be removed from traffic but not necessarily restarted.
Returns application information such as build details, git info, and custom info properties.
